Anna Chen: Heads-up: running into weird graceful-shutdown + streaming issues when our k8s pod SIGTERMs — Node SDK streams sometimes hang, Python closes late and leaves sockets open. Anyone seen a cross-SDK pattern for clean shutdown?

Raj Patel: Yup. Common pattern: short-circuit retries + explicitly cancel active stream bodies. On Node you usually need to call `response.body.cancel()` or use the AbortSignal tied to the HTTP request before process exit. Example:```js
const ac = new AbortController();
fetch(url, { signal: ac.signal })
  .then(res => { // stream handling })
// on SIGTERM
ac.abort(); // ensures stream handlers get cancelled
```

Oliver Ng: For Python we wrap the client lifecycle. Use an async contextmanager and `await stream.aclose()` then `await client.close()` in shutdown hook. If you rely on GC, loop can hang. Also watch retry middleware that re-enqueues on exception.

Taylor Reid: Go pattern: `ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(rootCtx)` then `server.Shutdown(ctx)` and pass `ctx` into request handlers so any in-flight request sees cancel. Do not rely on net/http connection close alone.

Sasha Gomez: Mobile / WASM note: older runtimes don't have AbortController. We added `client.shutdown()` helper in the mobile SDK that attempts a best-effort cancel and stops the retry queue. Might be worth adding similar helper to other SDKs as a common primitive.

Anna Chen: Quick question — do retries/backoff create extra late requests during shutdown? I saw duplicate inflight attempts after SIGTERM.

Raj Patel: Yes — our existing retry queue doesn't check for a canceled lifecycle. Fix is to short-circuit retry loop when the abort signal/context is done. Pseudocode:```py
while should_retry and not ctx.cancelled():
    try:
        await attempt()
    except Retryable: 
        await backoff.sleep()
```

Taylor Reid: I opened a draft PR that adds lifecycle hooks + a small test harness that asserts SDKs respect a 5s SIGTERM window and don't spawn lingering goroutines/threads. @Oliver @Raj please take a look: https://example.com/pr/1234 (draft).

Oliver Ng: Will review tomorrow. Add CI job that sends SIGINT to the container and waits for process exit + checks for no goroutine leaks. For Python add `pytest-timeout` assertion that event loop finishes.

EngRuntime Oncall: Also flagging a runtime-side item: ensure the serving runtime flushes KV/prefix caches on client disconnect. Some streams can leave KV caches in a transient state; adding an explicit `flush_kv_cache()` on graceful shutdown helped in one customer case.

Devex Bot: deploy scheduled: staging graceful-shutdown test window 2026-03-18T02:00Z :white_check_mark:

Anna Chen: Thanks everyone. Assigning owners: Node -> @Raj, Python -> @Oliver, Go -> @Taylor. I'll add the matrix to the RFC doc and link tests. Ping me if you need test infra. :thumbsup:
